description.value: Showcase Restaurant & Bar is a casual-dining restaurant inside the Vancouver Marriott Pinnacle Downtown in Coal Harbour. It features West Coast cuisine with seasonally inspired menus emphasizing locally and regionally sourced ingredients, plus a bar with local craft beers, BC wines, and hand-crafted cocktails. The restaurant also offers breakfast, brunch, and private event dining, making it a convenient stop in the downtown core.
